stages.english: Density is mass divided by volume. A sample with a mass of 20 grams and a volume of 10 millilitres has a density of 2 grams per millilitre.
stages.chinese: 密度等于质量除以体积。质量 20 克、体积 10 毫升的样品，密度为 2 克每毫升。

stages.english: One gram per millilitre equals 1000 kilograms per cubic metre.
stages.chinese: 1 克每毫升等于 1000 千克每立方米。

stages.english: The same sample therefore has a density of 2000 kilograms per cubic metre. Changing units does not change the material or its density as a physical quantity.
stages.chinese: 同一样品的密度因此为 2000 千克每立方米；更换单位并未改变物质或密度这一物理量。

stages.english: A different sample has density 1 gram per millilitre. It has half the density of the first sample, not twice the density.
stages.chinese: 另一份样品的密度为 1 克每毫升，是第一份样品密度的一半，并非两倍。
